name: PageLamp
description: PageLamp design tokens (docs/design/macos-shell.md §10). One base set plus five orthogonal modifiers; later entries in resolutionOrder win, so increased contrast and reduced transparency override the Mica backdrop. Modifier $extensions["dev.pagelamp"].css tells gen-tokens.mjs how a context reaches CSS (a selector on <html>, optionally also a media query). The native Mac app resolves platform=macos, backdrop=none, transparency=auto and emits theme × contrast as the four NSAppearance variants.

base.description: Light theme, normal contrast, macOS, no backdrop, transparency auto.

theme.description: Light or dark appearance (Tauri: the .dark class on <html>; Mac: aqua / darkAqua).

platform.description: Which platform the Tauri app runs on (data-platform on <html>). The native Mac app always resolves macos.

backdrop.description: Window backdrop decided in Rust at startup: Mica on Windows 11 ≥ 22621, otherwise an opaque window.

contrast.description: Normal or increased contrast (Mac: accessibilityHighContrastAqua / …DarkAqua; web: data-contrast="more" or prefers-contrast: more).

transparency.description: Reduce Transparency (web: data-transparency="reduced" or prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce; the in-app toggle exists because WebKitGTK lacks the media query). The Mac handles it in views (§7.2), not in colours.
